messages:
alex: Heads-up: we're introducing a new header `X-Cost-Center` (SDKs: py/ts/go) in v1.10 to standardize billing attribution across console + exports. This will replace `X-Billing-Tag`. Rationale: clearer semantics for cost-center driven billing and per-team dashboards. :eyes:
priya: Is this going to change how quota attribution works? we can't have customers suddenly see a different burn distribution.
nate: big +1 on that concern. If both headers are present we need to avoid double attribution.
alex: plan: ingestion will canonicalize to `cost_center` (preferred header `X-Cost-Center`). If `X-Billing-Tag` is present and `X-Cost-Center` is absent, map it to `cost_center`. If both present, prefer `X-Cost-Center` and drop the other. We'll keep a 60-day compatibility window where telemetry emits both keys (old->new alias) to prevent dashboard breakage.
li: telemetry note: current schema uses `billing_tag` in events. We'll emit `cost_center` as the primary field and add `billing_tag` as an alias for the fallback window. I'll open a schema PR and add pipeline tests.
devex-bot: reminder: add migration snippets to each SDK changelog + a deprecation warning in responses for 4 weeks before full enforcement. :memo:
alex: docs snippets (python): ```python
headers = {"X-Cost-Center": "cc-42:ml-research"}
resp = client.generate("Summarize...", headers=headers)
```
nate: TS SDK wrinkle: fetch-based runtimes tend to lowercase header names. We'll ensure the TS helper uses Headers.set('X-Cost-Center', ...) (not raw header object) and add unit tests asserting outgoing request contains the canonical header name/value. Also add a note in the upgrade guide about proxy behavior (Vercel/Edge runtimes).
ben: Go client: http.Header canonicalizes keys (CanonicalMIMEHeaderKey), so header injection should be fine. Suggest adding ClientOptions.CostCenter string so server-side users can set it without fiddling with raw headers. Also update examples in go-sdk README.
jordan: adding a typed field in client constructors is good for ergonomics. for TS/py we can add optional param cost_center in options.
sam: console work: ingestion needs to normalize and dedupe. I'll add a dashboard tile that breaks down usage by `cost_center` and include a small badge that reads "(was X-Billing-Tag)" during migration. Will also add filters to exports.
priya: quota engine: switch attribution precedence to use `cost_center` when present, falling back to tenant id otherwise. We need e2e tests to ensure quota isn't double-spent when both headers come through legacy proxies.
ops-bot: canary deployed to canary-cc (namespace) at 2024-06-01T09:00Z 1% traffic.
li: i'll land telemetry PR and emit both fields for 60 days, tests in metrics pipeline to assert dedupe behavior.
alex: timeline: canary next week, full rollout target 2024-06-15. SDKs should ship v1.10 release with deprecation warnings one week before full rollout.
devex-bot: checklist created: SDK changelog entries, docs migration guide, sample nginx/envoy config fragments, console tile mockups. :white_check_mark:
jordan: action items assigned: add cost_center param to TS/py client constructors + unit tests (jordan/nate), go helper & README (ben), console ingestion + dashboard (sam/priya), telemetry schema PR (li), migration doc (devex).
alex: thanks everyone. i'll prepare a short RFC for the deprecation schedule and customer email templates. we'll monitor cost-center attribution and billing exports closely during the compatibility window. :party_parrot:
devex-bot: migration doc stub created at sources/docs/migrations/cost-center-header.md (internal link).
